newsitem.title: DUBAI: UAE puts lube refinery on fast track - ADNOC.
newsitem.headline: UAE puts lube refinery on fast track - ADNOC.

text.p: Abu Dhabi National Oil Company (ADNOC) will bring onstream a 250,000 tonnes a year lube base oil refinery in 2001 at its existing Ruwais refinery plant, ADNOC said in a company magazine.
"Instructions have been given to put the project on a fast track. The ADNOC base oil refinery is planned to come on stream in the year 2001," ADNOC News reported.
The plant will supply local and export markets, it said.
"This facility's production is expected to largely replace the UAE's imports of base oils," it added.

ADNOC is implementing a $1.4 billion expansion and upgrading plan at Ruwais involving the construction of two condensate trains and kerosene and naphtha units in 1999 and a new crude distillation column for completion early in the next decade.

The state-owned oil firm in February this year also approved the construction of a a new petrochemical complex to produce ethylene di-chloride (EDC) close to the site of its 135,000 barrels per day (bpd) Ruwais oil refinery.
